questions.question: In digital logic synthesis, what is the primary architectural trade-off of employing 'One-Hot' state encoding compared to minimal-bit binary encoding for a Finite State Machine (FSM)?
options: It minimizes the number of state flip-flops required to ceil(log2 N), reducing total die area at the cost of slower transitions.
It eliminates all dynamic switching power because only one state bit switches per transition, unlike Gray encoding.
It completely prevents combinational glitches and race conditions without requiring synchronizers across asynchronous clock domains.
It uses exactly one flip-flop per state, which simplifies next-state combinational decoding logic and often enables higher operating frequencies, at the expense of using more flip-flops.
It allows the FSM to transition directly between arbitrary states without going through any clock cycle delays.

questions.question: In digital arithmetic circuit design, how does a Carry-Lookahead Adder (CLA) fundamentally overcome the critical path delay limitation of a Ripple Carry Adder (RCA)?
options: By pre-computing carry generate and carry propagate signals for all bit positions in parallel, allowing all carry bits to be derived through wide multi-level logic without waiting for ripples from preceding stages.
By evaluating the sum bits sequentially while buffering intermediate carries using high-drive clock-gated registers.
By utilizing transmission gates rather than static CMOS logic to propagate the carry signal without incurring transistor gate delays.
By computing two addition results simultaneously (one assuming a carry-in of 0 and one assuming 1) and selecting the correct result with a multiplexer.
By converting standard binary inputs into redundant signed-digit representations to eliminate carry generation entirely.

questions.question: In CMOS digital IC low-power design, why does Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) yield an approximately cubic reduction in dynamic power dissipation when supply voltage and clock frequency are scaled down concurrently?
options: Because clock distribution networks consume power proportional to Vdd^4, which averages out to Vdd^3 across the chip.
Because gate oxide leakage current scales exponentially with voltage while subthreshold leakage scales quadratically with frequency.
Because the switching activity factor decreases quadratically with clock frequency while load capacitance shrinks linearly with voltage.
Because lowering the supply voltage reduces junction temperature, which in turn causes an independent linear drop in dynamic capacitance.
Because dynamic power depends quadratically on supply voltage (P = a * C * Vdd^2 * f) and maximum operating frequency scales approximately linearly with supply voltage in super-threshold operation.

questions.question: At sub-22nm technology nodes, why did the semiconductor industry transition from conventional planar bulk MOSFETs to 3D FinFET (and subsequently Gate-All-Around) transistor architectures?
options: To replace silicon channels with high-mobility III-V materials that require vertical gate geometries to prevent mechanical strain failure.
To improve electrostatic gate control by wrapping the gate around multiple sides of a thin vertical channel, thereby suppressing short-channel effects and subthreshold leakage.
To eliminate gate dielectric tunneling leakage entirely by utilizing the vertical fin sidewalls as physical insulators.
To avoid using chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) in the manufacturing process by building transistors purely vertically above the substrate.
To double the clock frequency by utilizing both electron and hole conduction simultaneously within a single physical fin.

questions.question: In shared-memory multiprocessor cache hierarchies, what is the specific operational purpose of the 'Owner' (O) state in the MOESI cache coherence protocol compared to the standard four-state MESI protocol?
options: It marks a cache line as clean and unshared, allowing a core to modify it silently without issuing a bus invalidation transaction.
It designates the cache line that holds the single authoritative lock for synchronization primitives like compare-and-swap (CAS).

It allows a modified (dirty) cache line to be shared across multiple caches simultaneously without writing it back to main memory first, designating one cache to service read requests and perform eventual writeback.
It tracks which processor core currently possesses the hardware directory pointer for speculative out-of-order instruction replay.
It allows an evicted line to bypass lower-level caches and write directly into non-volatile storage to preserve persistent memory guarantees.
